component.name: Aurora Waves
أمواج أورورا
component.summary: World radio, YouTube Music and your own music

description.p: A frosted-glass music player that brings three sources together, with an animated aurora that takes its colors from what you are listening to.

ul.li: World radio: tens of thousands of live stations in 220+ countries from Radio Browser and zeno.fm, by name, country and genre. Arabic searches also find Latin spellings.
YouTube Music (optional): search songs, artists and albums, a home feed in your language, queues, similar-song radio and synced lyrics.
Optional sign-in through the browser you already use, for your liked songs, playlists, history and personal recommendations.
Your own music: files, folders and M3U/PLS playlists, with shuffle, pause and seek.
Check and repair listens to every station to confirm real audio and suggests tested replacements.
Media keys, desktop media controllers and the lock screen (MPRIS), and a tray icon.
English and Arabic, with left-to-right and right-to-left layouts.

description.p: Not affiliated with Google or YouTube.

screenshot.caption: Home: your stations and YouTube Music suggestions

ul.li: Now on the Snap Store (edge channel first)
Every package is built and tested automatically before it is published
Home tells you when there is no internet connection, with a retry button
Desktop file accepted by older validators (Ubuntu 22.04)
Follows the desktop's light or dark style by default
Quits at once, even while something is still loading
AppImage: bundles the small X11 libraries Qt needs, for fresh systems
The window shrinks down to a mini player; bottom tabs on narrow windows
Closing the window quits; keeping the app in the tray is optional
Store packages never download code; they get yt-dlp updates through the store

description.p: First version of the desktop app.
